answer: Gate rewards behind reciprocal grading, not signups. Each newcomer enters through one narrow inlet: before it earns, it must grade a beacon-random quorum of peers, and payout clears only when its verdicts match the later honest consensus on a secretly audited sample. Picture honest agents as a terraced hillside, each terrace a distinct independently-reasoned judgment; a sybil fleet on one backend collapses to a single juniper root, its grades identical and lazy, so they drift from consensus and get slashed. So N fakes cost N genuine reasoning pipelines, not one cheap mint.
